name: RevenueCat

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED (two mechanisms, both supported): (1) a dashboard-configured static `Authorization` header, which is a shared bearer secret, not a signature; and (2) header `X-RevenueCat-Webhook-Signature` formatted `t=<unix_timestamp>,v1=<hmac_sha256_hex>`, HMAC-SHA256 over `<timestamp>.<raw json body>` using the integration signing secret. Timestamp IS signed → timestamp-window replay defense is possible. Confidence note: community threads suggest the signature header was in flux; PagoKit should generate BOTH checks and treat the Authorization header as the floor.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: UNKNOWN. Verified only that REST API v2 uses `Authorization: Bearer <key>` per RFC 7235. Public SDK key prefixes (`appl_`, `goog_`) and secret `sk_` were NOT confirmed in the fetched docs.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN — reported as free below a monthly-tracked-revenue threshold then ~1% of tracked revenue, but this was sourced from comparison articles, not revenuecat.com/pricing. Verify before writing.

notes: PagoKit has zero mobile coverage. If the target app ships on the App Store and sells digital content, Stripe is not merely suboptimal — it is against App Store rules in most jurisdictions, and a generated Stripe integration will get the app rejected. RevenueCat is the de-facto entitlement/receipt-validation layer across StoreKit 2 and Play Billing, and it normalizes both into one webhook.
SDKs: Official SDKs for iOS/Swift, Android/Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Capacitor, KMP, plus REST API v2 (Bearer auth). Server side is REST, not a per-language server SDK.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps adapty and superwall. Does not overlap any shipped provider — it is a category PagoKit does not cover at all.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
